sources: https://www.altamontks.com/visit_altamont/idle_hour_lake/index.php (City of Altamont), read 2026-11-05: 'Louis P. Gartner Recreation Area / Idle Hour Lake'; 'We currently have 20 premier camping slots in two locations available on a reservation basis. Electricity, Water, Wi-Fi, Sewer Dumping Station, Fire Rings, Swing Set, and Picnic Tables. Each camping slot is approximately 78 feet long, by 30 feet wide (15 feet of rock, 15 feet of grass). Camping slots are available as close as 150 feet from the Water Front and are $15/night.'; 'We also have a nice laundry and shower-house available for work campers.'

https://www.altamontks.com/visit_altamont/idle_hour_lake/reservations.php, read 2026-11-05: 'TO MAKE A CAMPING RESERVATION ... Call Monday - Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (620) 784-5582'; '$15 per Night. All campsites include full hookup (electric, sewer, and water), a picnic table, grill, fire ring and free Wi-Fi. There are bathrooms, a shower house, and laundry facilities on site.'

https://www.altamontks.com/visit_altamont/idle_hour_lake/regulations.php, read 2026-11-05: 'No camper may be left for more than 60 days at a time. If the camper would like to request a longer stay, they may do so from the Altamont Governing Body ...'; 'Campsites number 1, 9, 19 and 20 are for short-term camping only with a maximum 14 day stay.'; 'RV Campsite: $15 per night (includes electric, water, sewer and Wi-Fi); Primitive Camping: Free (no access to campsite utilities or campsite parking)'; 'A notice of 48 hours must be given for cancellation of camping for a full refund ...'; 'RV camping is available from March 1 to December 31. The City reserves the right to change these dates due to weather ...'; payments at the City Office, its drop box, or altamontpayments.com

Esri World Imagery at the stored pin 37.14212,-95.2861 (400 m half) and at 37.14275,-95.2882 and 37.1397,-95.2866 (150 m half), 2026-11-05: the pin is on the entrance road at the highway. The north RV loop (centre ~37.14275,-95.2882, RVs on gravel pull-ins) sits ~50 m north of the lake across open grass and some shore brush, with a wooded lake arm ~50-60 m west; a second, wooded loop ~37.1397,-95.2866 lies east of the lakeshore road below the dam end. The lake is far over 5 acres (several hundred metres across in frame).

note: City of Altamont lake south of town (Louis P. Gartner Recreation Area), with fishing, trails, disc golf and a shelter house. 20 gravel-and-grass hookup slots in two areas, the nearest about 150 ft from the water. --Claude
summary: City pages confirm $15 full hookup (electric/water/sewer, Wi-Fi), 20 slots in two areas, showers/laundry/dump, RV camping Mar 1-Dec 31, phone reservations; 60-day max (14 at four sites). Added count, season dates, facilities wifi, booking max stay/note, fees note. Electric amps not stated (50 left). Lakeview kept.
flags: LONG-STAY CHECK (human decides; local, so tests are advisory): the city allows stays to 60 days (longer by council approval) on 16 of 20 slots, keeps only sites 1, 9, 19 and 20 short-term (14 days), says the shower/laundry house is 'available for work campers', and its rules cover 'lot care' and personal items left around campers. Against that it posts a $15 nightly rate and takes nightly reservations. I read it as a city campground with a long-stay/worker lean, not mostly seasonal, but whether transient nights are available is untested.

WATERFRONT lakeview kept: the city says slots are 'as close as 150 feet from the Water Front'; imagery shows the north RV loop ~50 m above the lake across open grass and shore brush (a lake far over 5 acres). Not on-water (grass and brush between, loop road on the lake side of some pads). The second, wooded loop east of the lakeshore road has no clear view.

PIN: stored 37.14212,-95.2861 is the park entrance road at the highway, ~200 m east of the north RV loop (37.14275,-95.2882) and ~250 m from the south loop. Under the threshold; optional move to the north loop.

PHONE 620-784-5582 is the reservation line on the city's page (city office main line 620-784-5612). WEBSITE correct. SAND: none. Max_rig_ft not written: the city gives slot size (~78 x 30 ft), not a rig limit; a 23-ft rig fits.
